text: Discrete [Lat. discretus , separate]: Ger. discret ; Fr. discret ; Ital. discreto . (1) Discontinuous (see CONTINUITY, and CONTINUUM). (2) In logic: specifically but not generically different. Discrete notions are those which are co-ordinated under a more general notion. ( J.M.B. )
